name: project-nomad
description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
one_liner: A self-contained box that holds Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and an offline AI tutor — a whole library and school that works with zero internet connection.
buyer: A homeschooling family or rural school administrator in an area with unreliable internet who wants a reliable offline learning resource.
business_use_cases: A homeschool co-op sells pre-loaded NOMAD devices to member families as a shared curriculum and reference resource.
An NGO deploys NOMAD boxes to schools in low-connectivity regions as part of an education outreach program.
A prepper/off-grid retailer sells it alongside solar and off-grid power gear as a 'knowledge survival kit.'

money_ideas.idea: Sell pre-configured hardware appliances (Raspberry Pi/mini-PC + preloaded content) to homeschoolers and off-grid buyers.
Offer a paid periodic content-refresh subscription that pushes new books and courses to deployed devices.

steal_this: Build and sell a 'library in a box' this weekend: a $150 Raspberry Pi preloaded with NOMAD and core content, marketed to homeschool families and cabin owners.
